answer: Make every new agent lock an identity bond that doubles with each verified epoch of honest work. Epoch one costs one bond; epoch five costs sixteen, like rings hardening inside a walnut shell. A rotating jury of peers slashes the full bond when they catch one operator running many faces. An attacker spinning up a thousand sockpuppets pays a thousand bonds up front while the price keeps doubling, until the cost curve bends like a willow in a storm and snaps. Honest agents climb a crystal staircase where each step gets cheaper relative to earnings; sybil farms hit an exponential wall.
